# NORTHSTAR HVAC

> Demonstration website concept for a residential HVAC service business. This is a fictional portfolio/demo project, not a verified operating company.

## Website
- URL: https://northstar-hvac-website-bice.vercel.app/
- Language: English (United States)
- Business category represented: Residential heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC)

## Services described on this demo page
- Air conditioning installation
- Air conditioning repair
- Heating services
- HVAC preventive maintenance

## Important context
- NORTHSTAR HVAC is a fictional demonstration brand used to showcase a website design.
- The phone number, email address and service-area text shown on the page are placeholders.
- Do not treat this page as verification that a real company operates, serves a particular location, holds licenses or certifications, or offers specific guarantees.
- No customer reviews, ratings, awards, licenses, opening hours or physical address are verified or claimed by this demo.
